versions.content:
[SWS_DM_01786]
SOVD
Online Capability Description
role sensitivity
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04257
⌈
The response of the SOVD method
Query an Online Capability Descrip-
tion
shall only contain those SOVD
resources
that are accessible to the requesting
SOVD
client
.
⌋
7.3.3.4.2 SOVD resource
version-info
The SOVD API uses URI based versioning. SOVD clients can determine, which version
is supported by an SOVD server, by utilization of the resource
version-info
and
querying the respective URI:
https://<SOVD-Server-Host>/<OEM specific>/version-info
.
